property_summary: After a successful withdrawBalance, a depositor receives exactly their deposited balance (one payout, contract balance returns to zero) — but with the zeroing moved after the external call, a re-entrant attacker finds a nonzero balance during the call, the nested withdrawal reverts, and no payout ever completes.
change_summary: Move the balance-zeroing statement after the external call so it is never executed when the call reverts, and a reentrancy window opens with a nonzero balance.
